options.title: Review rooming and bed allocation practices
options.description: Investigate and adjust policies related to rooming pace and bed allocation to ensure they align with physician capacity and bed availability.
options.local_fit: This option addresses the observed issue of long waits after rooming due to high bed occupancy and slow physician pace. By reviewing and potentially adjusting policies, the hospital can ensure that rooming practices are synchronized with physician availability and bed capacity.
options.possible_pressure_transfer: If this option is implemented, pressure may shift to the policy review team and the roles involved in rooming and bed allocation practices. They will need to coordinate and communicate any changes effectively to ensure a smooth transition.
options.how_we_would_know: The success of this option can be measured by tracking wait times after rooming and assessing patient satisfaction. If wait times decrease and patient complaints diminish, it would indicate a positive impact.
options.revisit_or_stop_if: If wait times after rooming remain high or patient complaints persist, it may be necessary to revisit and refine the policy adjustments or explore alternative solutions.

options.title: Improve physician pace and efficiency
options.description: Conduct a detailed analysis of physician workflow and identify factors contributing to slow pace. Implement strategies to enhance physician efficiency and reduce wait times.
options.local_fit: This option focuses on addressing the observed slow physician pace, which is a key contributor to long waits. By understanding the specific factors affecting physician efficiency, targeted interventions can be developed to improve their workflow.
options.possible_pressure_transfer: Implementing this option may shift pressure to the physician team and the roles involved in workflow optimization. They will need to collaborate closely to identify and address inefficiencies.
options.how_we_would_know: The effectiveness of this option can be evaluated by tracking physician pace and wait times. If physician pace improves and wait times decrease, it would indicate a positive outcome.
options.revisit_or_stop_if: If physician pace remains slow or wait times do not improve significantly, further investigation into systemic issues or resource constraints may be necessary.

recommendation.rationale: Reviewing rooming and bed allocation practices is recommended as it directly addresses the observed issue of long waits after rooming. This option aligns rooming practices with physician capacity and bed availability.
recommendation.would_change_if: If physician pace is found to be the primary issue, improving efficiency may become the leading option.

suggested_reviewers.why: Their expertise in policy evaluation and adjustment makes them well-suited to assess the recommended option and provide insights for potential adjustments.
